_readme: Famous Replays manifest. Every entry is verified against real fills before it ships (see lib/replay/famous.ts for the contract): pnl_usd is the sum of exchange closedPnl over the pinned episode's fills, detected with the repo's own episode detector over userFillsByTime / capture-store fills. Entries are code-reviewed here, in git — never a database table. Stories attribute reported context to sources; the numbers shown are only what the fills support.

entries.title: A scalper's day: 3,011 fills, −$503
entries.story: Ten hours and 3,011 real fills on one coin, ending −$502.97 — a single day of the wallet our copy-trading autopsy took as its run-1 subject.
entries.pnl_basis: Net realized PnL over the pinned episode — the sum of the exchange's own closedPnl per fill (3,011 fills).
entries.coverage_note: Replayed from the AlphaLens capture store; capture coverage for this wallet begins 2026-08-15. This is one episode, not the autopsy's measurement: run 1 replayed 7,499 COPIED trades over a different window and is reported in the research post, not here.
entries.research_context: This is the wallet our copy-trading autopsy used for run 1. That run is a separate measurement over a different window — 7,499 copied trades, 4.8% win rate, −$1,251 after frictions — and none of it is what this replay shows. What you see here is one of its trading days.

verified.method: Episode detected and summed with the repo's own detector over the wallet's real fills; both episode boundaries are real flat gaps over 10 minutes, and the doc rebuilds byte-identically.

entries.title: A swing trade: four days in TIA, −$522
entries.story: Thirteen fills across four days in TIA, ending −$522.11 — one position from one of the ten wallets our copy-trading autopsy took as its run-2 cohort.
entries.pnl_basis: Net realized PnL over the pinned episode — the sum of the exchange's own closedPnl per fill (13 fills).

This is one position, not the autopsy's measurement: run 2 replayed 28,318 COPIED trades across ten wallets over 13 months and is reported in the research post, not here.

That run is a separate measurement over a different window — 28,318 copied trades across all ten wallets, −$9,704 after frictions — and none of it is what this replay shows. What you see here is one of this wallet's positions.

entries.title: The $196M giveback
entries.story: The most-watched wallet of the tariff-crash era — reported to have made ~$190M shorting minutes before the October 10 announcement — unwound a $739M ETH long over fifteen January days for −$195.9M realized, ending with almost nothing in the account.
entries.pnl_basis: Net realized PnL over the pinned episode — the sum of the exchange's own closedPnl per fill (13,829 fills, peak position $739M).
entries.coverage_note: Exchange-retained fills: the position predates the retained window, so the replay opens mid-position and says so. The reported October 2025 tariff-short profits predate retained fills and are quoted from press, never shown as our numbers.

verified.method: Episode detected and summed with the repo's own detector over userFillsByTime fills, boundary-safe pagination, stable across independent load windows.

entries.title: The insider whale returns
entries.story: Ten days after the tariff crash, the same wallet was back in the water: retained fills open mid-short on October 20 and show a $235M BTC position exited for +$6.4M over three days.
entries.pnl_basis: Net realized PnL over the pinned episode — the sum of the exchange's own closedPnl per fill (10,558 fills).
entries.coverage_note: Exchange-retained fills begin 2025-10-20 mid-position: the short's reported opening (October 12–15) is not retained, so the replay covers the verified exit only and is labelled a partial picture.

verified.method: Episode detected and summed with the repo's own detector over userFillsByTime fills, boundary-safe pagination.

entries.title: The twelve-second liquidation
entries.story: A 50,000-ETH short built patiently over two months died in twelve seconds on August 19, 2026 — 1,614 forced fills unwound roughly $108M notional, and the round trip closed −$24.9M.
entries.pnl_basis: Net realized PnL over the pinned episode — the sum of the exchange's own closedPnl per fill (12,990 fills; a complete round trip from flat to flat).
entries.coverage_note: Exchange-retained fills cover the full round trip, including the final liquidation cascade (fills timestamped 2026-08-19 20:50:47–20:51:15 UTC). Press reported the loss as $26.66M for the liquidation day; the pinned round trip nets −$24.9M because the wallet had realized gains earlier in the episode.

verified.method: Episode detected and summed with the repo's own detector over userFillsByTime fills, boundary-safe pagination (the cascade's same-millisecond fills are exactly why the pagination fix exists).

entries.title: Aguila's giveback week
entries.story: AguilaTrades — famous for turning eight-figure unrealized profits into losses — ran a $240M BTC position into a −$6.3M round trip across three July days, 1,656 of the fills forced.

entries.coverage_note: Exchange-retained fills cover the full round trip. His widely reported −$35M June 2025 stretch predates the retained fills and is quoted from press, never shown as our numbers. 1h bars are past exchange candle retention for July 2025, so the replay uses 4h bars.

entries.withheld: Withheld 2026-08-26 pending re-verification. The gap-aware detector (lib/wallet-data/gaps.ts) finds TWO proven capture gaps inside this pinned episode in the fills the exchange serves today — 2025-07-29T07:46:26Z to 11:15:23Z (3.5h, 250.00 BTC of position change no served fill explains) and 2025-07-29T16:37:17Z to 07-30T12:10:42Z (19.6h, -64.64 BTC). An episode may not span a proven gap, so this one now splits into three, and the largest of them (ep:1753877442427-1754009508698) realized -$2,391,633.03 rather than the -$3,174,003.79 this entry states for the whole window. The stated figure was true of the fills verified on 2025-08-01; it is not a figure the player can reproduce today. Re-verify from a complete source (the Hyperliquid S3 archive) before republishing.

entries.title: qwatio's $520M forty-x short
entries.story: Two days after this wallet's 50x self-liquidation reportedly forced Hyperliquid to cap leverage, it was back with a BTC short that peaked at $521M — the retained tape shows +$5.0M realized across 36,926 fills before the records end with the position still open.
entries.pnl_basis: Net realized PnL over the pinned episode — the sum of the exchange's own closedPnl per fill (36,926 fills; the position outlives the retained fills, so this is a partial picture and labelled so).
entries.coverage_note: Exchange-retained fills for this wallet span only 2025-03-14 to 2025-03-18: the March 12 unwind that made it famous predates retention and is quoted from press, never shown as our numbers; the short is still open when the retained records end.

verified.method: Episode detected and summed with the repo's own detector over userFillsByTime fills, boundary-safe pagination.

entries.withheld: Withheld 2026-08-26 pending re-verification. Two proven capture gaps sit inside this pinned episode in the fills the exchange serves today — 2025-03-15T04:03:51Z to 10:12:37Z (6.1h, 65.19 BTC unexplained) and 2025-03-16T21:01:20Z to 03-17T09:23:25Z (12.4h, 593.85 BTC unexplained) — so the episode splits into three. Worse than a changed number: the doc route resolves a pinned range that no longer matches exactly by LARGEST TIME OVERLAP, and the longest of the three sub-episodes (ep:1742033557547-1742158880323, 34.8h) realized -$6,407.36. This page would have kept its +$5,030,904.75 headline over a replay of a $6.4k loss. Re-verify from a complete source (the Hyperliquid S3 archive) before republishing.

entries.title: A comeback trade: +$2.6M in HYPE
entries.story: Fifty-six hours and 23,734 fills in a $20M HYPE position, closed +$2,599,616.99 — one round trip out of the July–August window in which this wallet, reported liquidated 145 times after the October 2025 crash, ran net +$8.11M.
entries.pnl_basis: Net realized PnL over the pinned episode — the sum of the exchange's own closedPnl per fill (23,734 fills; a complete round trip from flat to flat, peak position $20.0M, fees $32,097.98 on top).
entries.coverage_note: Replayed from exchange-retained fills, NOT our capture store, and pinned to that source so the entry stays reproducible: at build time the store held ZERO fills in this episode's window, and its coverage of this wallet is actively changing (see below). THE FIGURE ABOVE IS THE EPISODE'S, NOT THE WINDOW'S — the replay plays the pinned 56-hour HYPE round trip and shows its own +$2,599,616.99 over 23,734 fills. The window totals below are context for the story only, and the two series MUST NEVER BE SUMMED. (1) EXCHANGE WINDOW, from 2026-07-07: measured to 2026-08-26T20:09:14Z, 191,707 fills, closed PnL +$8,588,386.64, fees $502,087.94, net +$8,086,298.70 (the reference measurement, also recorded in migration 018_capture_scope_machi.sql); an independent re-walk 28 minutes later, to 2026-08-26T20:37:20Z, returned 194,737 fills and +$8,622,358.65 — the 3,030-fill difference is live trading between the two cuts, not a disagreement. ETH-dominated either way (about +$7.9M of it). (2) OUR CAPTURE STORE, 2026-04-19 to 2026-06-29: 63,903 fills, realized -$1,019,426.43 as measured 2026-08-26. That store figure is a sum over the rows we hold, NOT a measurement of a continuous window: a 41.6-day hole sits inside it (2026-05-14 15:27 to 2026-06-25 05:12, when the wallet was out of capture scope). It is also growing — migration 018 brought this wallet into capture scope on 2026-08-26 and the daemon began backfilling what the API still retains, so a read later the same day returned 79,579 fills through 2026-07-23 at -$1,172,919.12. (3) Between the two series lies an 8-day hole, 2026-06-29 14:14 to 2026-07-07 04:44, held by neither source and unhealable — the API no longer retains it, so neither source can even say whether the wallet traded then.
entries.pending_verification: The October 10–11 2025 crash — when this wallet was reported to lose ~$14M and begin a run of 145 liquidations — is NOT verified here and contributes to no figure on this page. It predates both exchange retention for this wallet and our capture store; verifying it requires the Hyperliquid S3 archive (s3_backfill.py), which has not been run for this address. Until it is, the October episode is a reported claim, not a measurement.

verified.method: Episode detected and summed with the repo's own detector over an uncapped, instrumented walk of userFillsByTime (99 pages, 194,737 fills, zero same-millisecond overflows); the store window read separately by SQL aggregate. The two were never combined.
